statement:
The sequence \((x_n)\), \(n \in \mathbb{N}^*\), is defined by \(|x_1| < 1\) and \(x_{n+1} = \dfrac{-x_n + \sqrt{3 - 3x_n^2}}{2}\) for all \(n \geq 1\).
a) Find the necessary and sufficient condition on \(x_1\) so that each \(x_n > 0\).
b) Is this sequence periodic? Justify.

At least \(n-1\) numbers are removed from \(\{1, 2, \ldots, 2n-1\}\) according to the rules:
i) If \(a\) is removed, so is \(2a\);
ii) If \(a\) and \(b\) are removed, so is \(a+b\).
Find the way of removing numbers such that the sum of the remaining numbers is as large as possible.

A tetrahedron is cut by three planes forming a parallelepiped whose three faces and all vertices lie on the surface of the tetrahedron.
a) Can this be done so that the volume of the parallelepiped is at least \(\dfrac{9}{40}\) of the volume of the tetrahedron?
b) Determine the common point of the three planes if the parallelepiped volume is \(\dfrac{11}{50}\) of the tetrahedron volume.

A triangle \(ABC\) is given. Let \(M\) be an interior point and \(A', B', C'\) its projections on sides \(BC, CA, AB\) respectively. Find the locus of \(M\) for which \(MA \cdot MA' = MB \cdot MB' = MC \cdot MC'\).

Suppose \(f(x) = a_0 x^n + a_1 x^{n-1} + \cdots + a_n\) (\(a_0 \neq 0\)) is a polynomial with real coefficients satisfying \(f(x)f(2x^2) = f(2x^3 + x)\) for all \(x \in \mathbb{R}\). Prove that \(f(x)\) has no real roots.

Children sit around a circle. Each child starts with an even positive number of candies. A child gives half his candies to his right neighbor. If the recipient has an even number, he does the same; otherwise he receives one extra candy from the teacher first. Prove that after finitely many steps, one child will be able to give the teacher half his candies and make all children's candy counts equal.
